1.description: Seal of Command now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 5%.
Pyroblast now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Overpower now deals 35% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Mortal Strike now deals 40% reduced damage against players, from 35%.
Curse of Agony now deals 5% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Conflagrate no longer deals reduced damage against players. It previously had a PvP modifier of 5%.
Chaos Bolt now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Bloodthirst now deals 10% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Arcane Shot now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 25%.
Fixed a bug where Dismantle was usable while shapeshited.
Cheap Shot now lasts for 3.5 seconds, down from 4 seconds.
Cleaned up the tooltip of reckoning. It still shares an ICD with sword specialization and hack and slash, but it now says this within the reckoning buff instead of the talent tooltip.
Overpower now deals 120% weapon damage, from 110%.
Strength of Arms can now trigger from Execute.
King of the Jungle now reduces the mana cost of Bear and Cat Form by 15/30/45%, down from 20/40/60%.
[New Capstone]: Unending Fury - While Bloodrage is active Fear effect durations are reduced by 30% and a successful Whirlwind reduces the cooldown of your next Whirlwind by 2 seconds.
Divine Favor now increases the critical strike chance of ALL Holy spells by 100%.
Increased Frenzied Regeneration's duration to 12 seconds, up from 10. Each point of rage is now converted into 0.2% of max health, down from 0.3%.
Fixed an issue where Riposte would stack with other attack speed reducing debuffs.
Holy Shock no longer shares a cooldown with the Shaman Shock spells.
Improved Ambush is now called Out of Nowhere, and increases the critical strike chance of your Hemorrhage by 7/15% in addition to its previous effect.
Victory Rush now heals the player for 8% of their maximum health against players, down from 10%.
Mocking blow now deals 70% weapon damage to players.
Test of Faith now also increases the damage done by Smite and Holy Fire by 4/8/12% on targets at or below 50% health and the Capstone Bonus now includes Smite and Holy Fire in its effect.
Adjusted Blood Fury (racial) to also give healing power.
Clarified the tooltip of Freezing Strike to indicate that it can give two charges of Fingers of Frost when used while dual-wielding.
The cooldown of Chimera Pets' Froststorm Breath has been increased to 12 seconds, up from 10.
Fixed a tooltip error in Stormstrike.
The duration of Deep Freeze has been reduced to 3.5 seconds, down from 4.
Fixed an issue where Every Man for Himself would remove effects that are not in the tooltip.
Silencing Shot now travels 33% faster, making it easier to time correctly against enemies that are casting.
Healing from Living Seed will now be attributed to the caster in the combat log, instead of the target it is being cast on.
Fixed a tooltip error in Decimation.
Improved Counterattack Capstone now has a 30 second cooldown, down from 60 seconds.
Soul Leech now has a 33/66/100% proc chance, up from 25/50/75%.
Fixed Unrelenting Storm's tooltip to match the number of percentage haste gained per stack.
Abolish Curse can now be dispelled.
The Nightfall talent now reduces the cast time and mana cost of Seed of Corruption in addition to Shadow Bolt.
Abolish Poison, Abolish Disease, and Abolish Curse now all tick every 2 seconds, down from every 3 seconds, but now has a duration of 8 seconds, down from 12 seconds.
Increased the tick frequency of Tremor Totem to every 2 seconds, down from every 3 seconds.
Intensify Rage now also reduces the health cost of Bloodrage by 25/50/75%.
Clarified the tooltip of Blood and Guts.
Blink now has a 35 second cooldown, up from 30 seconds.
Reduced the range of Searing Pain (Perilous Pain) to 25 yards, down from 30 yards.
Improved Hammer of Justice will now increase the stun duration by 0.33/0.66/1 seconds, down from 0.5/1/1.5 seconds.
Reckoning will now function the same way as Hack and Slash, triggering an ability called Reckoning, instead of auto attack that does not proc effects like Flametongue or Poisons.
The duration of Intimidation on your pet has been reduced to 5 seconds, from 15.
Frozen Power now has a 10 second internal cooldown.
Hand of Freedom now has a 30 second cooldown, down from 35 seconds.
Defensive Mindset from leaving Defensive Stance will now be removed when entering Defensive Stance.
Blessing of Salvation now has a 1 second global cooldown, down from 1.5 seconds.
Adjusted the icon of the Felguard's Intercept immobilize effect.
Increased the global cooldown of Hamstring and Wing Clip to 1.5 seconds, up from 1 second.
Fixed an issue causing Dispersing Blast Wave to not work.
Changed the tooltip of Tactical Mastery to clarity that the debuff for the staggered damage is dealt over time for the next 10 seconds.
Fixed an issue where rank 3 Killer Instinct would not grant critical strike chance for melee and ranged attacks.
Fixed an issue where Vindication rank 3 had a lower proc chance than intended and would stay active after unlearning the talent.
Unrelenting Storm can now be triggered from dealing damage with Lightning Shield.

5.description:
Bangle of Endless Blessings (Normal).

Now grants 20 spirit and 20 spellpower. Previously had no stats.

Proc effect changed from: 
Equip: Your spell casts have a chance to allow 15% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec.

to:

Equip: Your spell casts have a chance to allow 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec.

On use upgraded from:
Use: Increases your Spirit by 130 for 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown)

to: 

Use: Increases your Spirit by 200 and increases your Healing Power by 10% of your spirit.

Bangle of Endless Blessings (Mythic).

Now grants 24 spirit and 24 spellpower. Previously had no stats.

Proc effect changed from: 
Equip: Your spell casts have a chance to allow 15% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec.

to:

Equip: Your spell casts have a chance to allow 25% of your mana regeneration to continue while casting for 15 sec.

On use upgraded from:
Use: Increases your Spirit by 140 for 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown)

to: 

Use: Increases your Spirit by 220 and increases your Healing Power by 12% of your spirit.

Warp-Scarab Brooch (Normal).

No longer increases MP5 by 16. Now grants 30 critical strike rating.
On use effect changed from: Use: Increases spell power by 150 for 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown). 

to: 

Use: Increases spell power by 169 for 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown)

Warp-Scarab Brooch (Mythic).

No longer increases MP5 by 16. Now grants 38 critical strike rating.
On use effect changed from: Use: Increases spell power by up 150 for 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown). 

to: 

Use: Increases spell power by 188 for 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown)

Auslese''s Light Chaneller (Normal) level 61 trinket.

No longer increases spellpower by 32.
No longer has an on-use effect.

Previous on use: Reduces the cost of your next spell cast within 10 sec by up to 215 mana. (3 minutes cooldown). 

It now has a passive effect: 
Healing with heal over time effects grant you 4 Haste Rating, stacking up to 5 times and lasts for 6 seconds.
Healing with a direct heal grants you 8 Spell Power, stacking up to 5 times and lasts for 6 seconds. Both effects have a separate 3 second cooldown.

Auslese''s Light Chaneller (Mythic)

Healing with heal over time effects grant you 6 Haste Rating, stacking up to 5 times and lasts for 6 seconds.
Healing with a direct heal grants you 12 Spell Power, stacking up to 5 times and lasts for 6 seconds. Both effects have a separate 3 second cooldown.

Figurine of the Colossus (Normal)

No longer increases shield block rating.
Increases Shield Block Value by 49.
Increases Defense Rating by 16.

On use changed from: 

Each successful block heals you for 100. Effect lasts 20 seconds 

to:

Each successful block heals you for 400. Effect lasts 20 seconds and is reduced significantly outside of instances.

Figurine of the Colossus (Mythic)

No longer increases shield block rating.
Increases Shield Block Value by 60.
Increases Defense Rating by 24.

On use upgraded to:

Each successful block heals you for 500. Effect lasts 20 seconds and is reduced significantly outside of instances.

Argussian Compass (Normal)


On Use changed from:

Use: Reduces damage from each attack by 68, up to a total of 1150 damage absorbed. Lasts 20 sec. (2 minutes cooldown)

to:

Reduces damage from each attack by 500, up to a total of 3000 damage absorbed. Lasts 10 seconds and is significantly reduced outside of instances.

Argussian Compass (Mythic)
Stamina Increased to 42

On Use Upgraded to:

Reduces damage from each attack by 550, up to a total of 3300 damage absorbed. Lasts 10 seconds and is significantly reduced outside of instances.

Adamantine Figurine (Normal): 
Changed to have no on-use.
No more passive stats.

Fully avoiding damage from an attack increases Stamina by 5. Taking direct damage increases your Defense and Dodge Rating by 4. Each effect stacks to 5 times and lasts for 8 secs.

Adamantine Figurine Mythic:
Changed to have no on-use.
No more passive stats.

Fully avoiding damage from an attack increases Stamina by 6. Taking direct damage increases your Defense and Dodge Rating by 5. Each effect stacks to 5 times and lasts for 8 secs.
Highlighting some of the trinket reworks coming with the release of mythic 0!

Rend now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Execute now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Insect Swarm now deals 15% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Flame Shock now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 10%.
Rake now deals 20% reduced damage against players, from 15%.
Claw now deals 10% reduced damage against players. It previously did not have a PvP modifier.
